newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey finds body from sunken Russian boat.
newsitem.headline: Turkey finds body from sunken Russian boat.

text.p: Turkish gendarmerie forces on Monday found the body of a missing crew member from a Russian boat that sunk in the Black Sea at the weekend but there was no sign of another six missing people, a local official said.
"The body was removed from the sharp rocks near the place the incident happen," an official from the governor's office in the town of Bartin told Reuters by telephone.
The dead man was identified as a 26-year-old Turk.

Four crew members were rescued shortly after the Russian-flagged passenger boat Moldavia hit rocks and went down near the coast on Saturday night. It was travelling from the eastern coastal city of Trabzon to Istanbul for repairs.
The official said local fishing boats and the gendarmerie would continue to search for the missing crew members.
"We want to believe that they are still alive," he said.
A Turkish company had been renovating the Moldavia to turn it into a 300-bed floating hotel with a cinema. It had not been to sea for four years.
